bullets.text: Promoted to Senior Mechanical Engineer in 2024 to direct operations across 3 manufacturing shops: Machine Shop, Drum Shop, and Fabrication Shop.
Managed an $18M financial portfolio comprising $8M in capital expenditure (CapEx) projects, a $9M maintenance parts & labor budget, and $1M in plant improvement initiatives.
Mentored and supervised 4 engineering interns, while directing multi-trade contractors, certified welders, machinists, and plant maintenance personnel.
Modernized heavy process equipment and tire-building tooling utilizing CNC machining, precision drum dynamic balancing, welding standards, and tight GD&T tolerancing.
Optimized spare parts inventory and work-order management through SAP PM / CMMS, cutting maintenance turnaround times and reducing operational downtime.
Serve as 24/7 technical authority for plant mechanical systems, leading root-cause failure analysis (RCA) and risk mitigation across global manufacturing operations.

experience.overview: Provided systems engineering for critical nuclear materials processing and facility operations.

bullets.text: Engineered safe mechanical system designs and standard operating procedures for nuclear materials processing facilities.
Researched industrial heat transfer systems and thermal efficiency opportunities to reduce facility energy consumption and operational costs.
Developed continuous improvement and reliability projects that reduced equipment maintenance downtime.
Delivered cross-departmental technical consultation, translating complex stakeholder requirements into validated engineering solutions.

projects.title: 3 Production Shops & $18M Capital/Maintenance Oversight
projects.summary: Directed 3 manufacturing shops (Machine, Drum, Fabrication), managed an $18M financial portfolio ($8M CapEx, $9M parts/labor, $1M CI), and mentored 4 engineering interns.
projects.description: Led complete operational and financial governance for critical manufacturing shops at Bridgestone Americas. Oversaw equipment maintenance budgets, spare parts supply chains in SAP PM, capital equipment modernizations, and day-to-day work-order execution across Machinists, Welders, and Fabricators.
highlights: In charge of Machine Shop, Drum Shop, and Fabrication Shop operations
Managed $8M in CapEx projects and $9M maintenance parts & labor budget
Supervised and mentored 4 engineering interns in heavy manufacturing
Streamlined maintenance work-orders and spare parts inventory in SAP PM

projects.title: Tire Building Drum & Tooling Modernization Program
projects.summary: Modernized heavy tire building drums, tooling, and fabrication workflows with CNC machining, precision balancing, and rigorous GD&T standards.
projects.description: Engineered custom manufacturing tooling and managed rebuild/refurbishment workflows for high-value tire building drums. Established quality inspection standards, dynamic balancing protocols, and precision machining tolerances to eliminate manufacturing variations and extend drum service life.
highlights: Directed high-precision Drum Shop rebuilds and dynamic balancing procedures
Implemented tight GD&T tolerancing and dimensional inspection workflows
Coordinated with certified welders and machinists on custom tooling fabrication
Reduced drum turnaround time and eliminated recurring tooling defects

projects.title: Nuclear Facility Heat Transfer & Energy Optimization
projects.summary: Researched industrial heat transfer systems and energy recovery opportunities at Savannah River Nuclear Solutions to lower operational costs and improve thermal efficiency.
projects.description: Evaluated process heat transfer systems, thermodynamics, and energy utilization within high-stakes nuclear facilities. Modeled thermal efficiency gains, evaluated cooling fluid dynamics, and proposed continuous improvement initiatives that reduced maintenance downtime and operational energy consumption.
highlights: Identified heat transfer optimization and facility energy savings opportunities
Ensured rigorous safe system designs and regulatory operating procedures
Formulated continuous improvement projects to reduce long-term maintenance downtime
Collaborated across specialized multi-department engineering and operations teams

projects.title: 24/7 Plant Mechanical Systems Risk Prevention & Uptime
projects.summary: Served as primary 24/7 technical authority for high-stakes rubber mixing mechanical systems, preventing unplanned downtime through proactive equipment evaluation.
projects.description: Provided around-the-clock engineering support and technical ownership for high-throughput heavy manufacturing equipment. Performed failure analysis, root cause investigations, and reliability engineering to eliminate chronic failure modes, protect personnel safety, and maintain high plant availability.
highlights: Primary 24/7 technical expert for heavy mechanical systems and emergency troubleshooting
Conducted root-cause failure analysis (RCA) and implemented permanent mechanical fixes
Developed predictive inspection procedures and updated technical engineering documentation
Managed emergency turnaround repairs with maintenance crew leaders and fabricators

projects.title: Data Center & Critical Cooling Thermal Calculator
projects.summary: Interactive thermodynamics calculator estimating critical facility cooling airflow (CFM), heat rejection tonnage, and annual energy savings across varying PUE targets.
projects.description: An interactive engineering calculation tool implementing fundamental thermodynamics (Q = m * Cp * dT) to determine required cooling air delivery, sensible cooling tonnage, and energy savings for high-density IT and plant facilities.
highlights: Live calculation of CFM airflow, total heat rejection, and refrigeration tonnage
Dynamic PUE sensitivity modeling with energy cost savings projection
Demonstrates mechanical thermal fluid principles applied to mission-critical infrastructure

projects.title: Parametric CAD Assembly Viewer (3D WebGL)
projects.summary: Interactive 3D mechanical assembly viewer with real-time kinematic explode view, wireframe mode, and parametric component inspection.
projects.description: Showcases mechanical design principles directly in WebGL using Three.js. Features a pillow-block bearing and bracket assembly with multi-part hierarchy (base plate, upright walls, bearing sleeve, precision shaft, fastener hardware) and dynamic orbit/explode controls.
highlights: Hierarchical multi-part 3D CAD visualization in WebGL
Kinematic slider for explode-view assembly inspection
Demonstrates integration of mechanical engineering with interactive web technologies

projects.title: Euler-Bernoulli Beam Deflection Calculator
projects.summary: Closed-form Euler-Bernoulli beam solver calculating maximum deflection, bending stress, and moment distributions under various support and loading conditions.
projects.description: Computes exact closed-form solutions for beam deflection under point and distributed loads for both simply-supported and cantilever configurations. Features real-time elastic curve rendering, section modulus calculation, and material modulus selection.
highlights: Rigorous closed-form structural mechanics formulas without external blackbox libraries
Real-time canvas rendering of beam deformation curve and support reactions
Computes peak fiber bending stress and compares against material limits

projects.title: Software Engineering, Automations & Web Tools
projects.summary: Engineered modern software automations, web applications, and data analysis pipelines to streamline technical reporting and operational workflows.
projects.description: Combines mechanical engineering depth with full-stack programming capabilities. Developed custom automation scripts and web tools for engineering calculations, automated reporting, data visualization, and plant communication.
highlights: Built responsive web applications and automated data collection pipelines
Bridged physical plant hardware and enterprise data systems
Applies modern deep learning and algorithmic automation to complex technical problems
